"""An entry point that reads its arguments by hand instead of calling the composition."""

import sys

from language_service.app import create_app
from language_service.server import serve


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    if len(argv) != 2:
        print("usage", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    if argv[0] != "--port":
        print("usage", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    port = int(argv[1])
    secret = sys.stdin.buffer.readline().rstrip(b"\n")
    if not secret:
        print("no secret", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    serve(create_app(secret), port, sys.stdin.buffer)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
